papers.title: Comparative connectomics reveals stage-specific gap junction rewiring that reshapes avoidance behavior
papers.translated_title: 比较连接组学揭示阶段特异性缝隙连接重连重塑回避行为
papers.author: Choe, D. T.
papers.summary: Environmental stress can remodel neural circuits, yet how such rewiring generates behavioral adaptation remains poorly understood. Here, we investigated how dauer-specific circuit remodeling alters nociceptive behavior. We discovered that dauers exhibit significantly shorter avoidance durations than adults. Through comparative connectomics, we observed a substantial expansion of gap junctions within the dauer nociceptive circuit and found that dauer neurons exhibit more transient activity dynamics as a result of this rewiring. Modeling neuronal activity demonstrated that removing dauer-specific connectivity constraints failed to reproduce transient characteristics, validating the functional role of dauer-specific gap junctions. Furthermore, introducing synthetic dauer-specific gap junctions into adults was sufficient to recapitulate dauer-like activity patterns and shorten avoidance duration. Despite extensive rewiring, avoidance initiation remained preserved across developmental stages. Our findings show that the dauer neural circuit is selectively rewired through gap junction remodeling to balance flexibility and stability for survival under stress.
papers.translated_summary: 环境胁迫能够重塑神经环路，然而这种重连如何产生行为适应仍知之甚少。本文研究了dauer期特异性环路重塑如何改变伤害感受行为。我们发现dauer期的回避持续时间显著短于成虫。通过比较连接组学，我们观察到dauer期伤害感受环路中缝隙连接大幅扩展，并发现dauer期神经元由于这种重连而表现出更为瞬态的活动动力学。神经元活动建模表明，去除dauer期特异性连接约束无法重现瞬态特征，验证了dauer期特异性缝隙连接的功能作用。此外，将人工dauer期特异性缝隙连接引入成虫足以重现类dauer期活动模式并缩短回避持续时间。尽管发生了广泛重连，回避启动在各发育阶段均得以保留。我们的发现表明，dauer期神经环路通过缝隙连接重塑被选择性重连，以在胁迫下平衡生存所需的灵活性与稳定性。

papers.title: Repurposing clofarabine against enteric pathogens via metabolic starvation
papers.translated_title: 通过代谢饥饿重新利用氯法拉滨对抗肠道病原体
papers.author: Deans, N. D.
papers.summary: Enteropathogenic and enterohaemorrhagic Escherichia coli (EPEC/EHEC) cause severe global diarrhoeal disease, exacerbated by rising antimicrobial resistance. Pathogenesis relies on "attaching and effacing" lesions, where bacteria generate actin pedestals to adhere, replicate, and destroy intestinal microvilli. To identify novel anti-virulence candidates targeting this process, we conducted a high-throughput phenotypic screen quantifying pedestal formation via high-content fluorescence microscopy. We identified the anticancer nucleotide analogue clofarabine as a potent inhibitor of EPEC growth and pathogenesis. Distinct from its oncology mechanism - inducing DNA chain termination and apoptosis - clofarabine competes with bacterial ATP-dependent processes to impede gene transcription, protein synthesis, and Type III Secretion System (T3SS) function. Remarkably, EPEC counteracts this inhibition by cleaving clofarabine, enabling restored protein synthesis and resumed growth. Furthermore, we report for the first time that clofarabine suppresses protein translation in human monocytes, suggesting an uncharacterised translational impact on mammalian cells. These findings reveal host and bacterial translation as interconnected vulnerabilities to purine antimetabolites, offering a novel strategy to disarm enteric pathogens while uncovering a bacterial enzymatic mechanism for neutralizing host-targeted therapeutics.
papers.translated_summary: 肠致病性和肠出血性大肠杆菌（EPEC/EHEC）在全球范围内引起严重的腹泻疾病，而日益加剧的抗菌药物耐药性使这一问题更加严峻。其致病机制依赖于“附着与抹平”病变，即细菌生成肌动蛋白基座以黏附、增殖并破坏肠道微绒毛。为寻找靶向该过程的新型抗毒力候选药物，我们通过高内涵荧光显微镜定量基座形成，开展了高通量表型筛选。我们鉴定出抗癌核苷酸类似物氯法拉滨是EPEC生长和致病性的强效抑制剂。与其肿瘤学机制——诱导DNA链终止和细胞凋亡——不同，氯法拉滨与细菌的ATP依赖性过程竞争，从而阻碍基因转录、蛋白质合成和III型分泌系统（T3SS）功能。值得注意的是，EPEC通过切割氯法拉滨来对抗这种抑制，从而恢复蛋白质合成并重新开始生长。此外，我们首次报道氯法拉滨可抑制人单核细胞中的蛋白质翻译，提示其对哺乳动物细胞具有尚未阐明的翻译影响。这些发现揭示了宿主和细菌的翻译过程是嘌呤抗代谢物的相互关联的脆弱靶点，提供了一种解除肠道病原体武装的新策略，同时揭示了一种中和宿主靶向治疗药物的细菌酶学机制。

papers.title: The nucleus spatially partitions mechanoprotection and mechanosensing
papers.translated_title: 细胞核在空间上分隔机械保护与机械感知
papers.author: Bouzignac, R.
papers.summary: Mechanical forces shape cell behavior, but how the nucleus integrates its roles as genome protector and mechanosensor remains unresolved. Here, we dissect the spatiotemporal control of transcriptional response to forces during epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT). By combining genome-wide approaches, in vivo nuclear micromanipulation, and quantitative live imaging, we uncover two key properties of nuclear mechanosensing. First, mechanically induced changes in chromatin accessibility and transcription are spatially patterned within the nucleus: genes closest to deformations appear protected, revealing a local shielding mechanism associated with chromatin closure. Second, relocating a gene between chromatin environments is sufficient to alter its mechanosensitivity, challenging the concept of inherently force-sensitive genes. These findings demonstrate unexpected spatial partition of nuclear response to forces.
papers.translated_summary: 机械力塑造细胞行为，但细胞核如何整合其作为基因组保护者和机械感受器的双重角色仍未被阐明。在此，我们解析了上皮-间质转化（EMT）过程中转录对力学响应的时空调控。通过结合全基因组方法、体内细胞核微操纵和定量活细胞成像，我们揭示了细胞核机械感受的两个关键特性。第一，机械诱导的染色质可及性和转录变化在细胞核内呈现空间模式化：最靠近形变区域的基因似乎受到保护，揭示了一种与染色质闭合相关的局部屏蔽机制。第二，将一个基因在染色质环境之间重新定位足以改变其机械敏感性，这对固有机械敏感基因的概念提出了挑战。这些发现证明了细胞核力学响应存在意想不到的空间分区。

papers.title: Integrating Long-Read Structural Variant Analysis with single-nucleus RNA-seq to Elucidate Gene Expression Effects in Disease
papers.translated_title: 将长读长结构变异分析与单核RNA测序整合以阐明疾病中的基因表达效应
papers.author: Kim, K.
papers.summary: Structural variants (SVs) are a major source of genetic diversity, yet how they impact cell types in complex brain diseases remains largely unexplored, partially due to limitations of short-read sequencing. Here, we addressed this fundamental question in Parkinson's disease (PD). generating long-read whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data for 100 post-mortem brain samples from a PD cohort, constructing a high-confidence catalog of 74,552 SVs. To resolve their functional impact, we integrated single-nucleus RNA-sequencing data from two brain regions from the same samples and focused functional analyses on SVs proximal to genes previously nominated as cis-regulated, potential causal targets of PD-associated GWAS loci. Using expression quantitative trait locus and allele-specific expression analyses, we uncovered SVs significantly associated with expression in specific cell types as well as effects shared across cell types. This study demonstrates the power of uniting long-read WGS with transcriptomics to uncover SVs underlying complex disease architecture with cell type resolution.
papers.translated_summary: 结构变异（SVs）是遗传多样性的主要来源，然而它们如何影响复杂脑疾病中的细胞类型在很大程度上仍未被探索，部分原因是短读长测序的局限性。在此，我们在帕金森病（PD）中解决了这一基本问题，为来自一个PD队列的100份死后脑样本生成了长读长全基因组测序（WGS）数据，构建了一个包含74,552个SVs的高置信度目录。为了解析其功能影响，我们整合了来自同一样本两个脑区的单核RNA测序数据，并将功能分析聚焦于先前被认定为顺式调控的、PD相关GWAS位点潜在因果靶点的基因附近的SVs。利用表达数量性状位点和等位基因特异性表达分析，我们发现了在特定细胞类型中与表达显著相关的SVs以及在细胞类型间共享的效应。本研究展示了将长读长WGS与转录组学相结合以细胞类型分辨率揭示复杂疾病架构下SVs的力量。

papers.title: Multimodal imaging links molecular identity with nanoscale-resolved 3D cell morphology in opossum cortical cultures
papers.translated_title: 多模态成像将分子身份与负鼠皮层培养物中纳米级分辨的三维细胞形态联系起来
papers.author: Ayar, Z.
papers.summary: In the mammalian central nervous system (CNS), the ability to regenerate after injury drops sharply in the first weeks after birth, but how this change is reflected in cell morphology and organization is still not fully understood. Here we cultivated cortical cell cultures from the gray short-tailed opossum (Monodelphis domestica) and compared cells derived from early postnatal pups (postnatal day 3-6, "Pyoung") with those from older pups (postnatal day 16-18, "Pold"), which differ in their capacity to regenerate after injury. For each culture, we assessed marker-defined cellular composition using fluorescently labeled markers for neurons, glia, and immature/progenitor cells, and characterized their nanoscale-resolved three-dimensional morphology using label-free scanning ion conductance microscopy (SICM). Pyoung cultures exhibited active change in shape over time, contained a higher proportion of immature SOX2 cells, and grew more neurites (TUJ1) into the lesion site after injury. Moreover, Pold cultures showed more stable soma size (e.g., thickness, area, volume), a larger astroglial (SOX9) population early in culture, and a glia-dominated lesion response. These early astroglia included more immature or reactive (vimentin) astrocytes. SICM further revealed cellular bridges across the lesion, ridges left in the substrate by the injury, and aligned neurite outgrowth. Across all measurements, changes in molecular markers were associated with corresponding changes in cell morphology. This multimodal combination of fluorescence labeling and SICM therefore relates marker-defined cellular composition to physical organization across micro- and nanoscale features during and after postnatal in vitro development.
papers.translated_summary: 在哺乳动物中枢神经系统(CNS)中，损伤后的再生能力在出生后最初几周内急剧下降，但这种变化如何反映在细胞形态和组织结构上仍未被完全理解。本研究培养了灰短尾负鼠(Monodelphis domestica)的皮层细胞培养物，并比较了来自出生早期幼崽(出生后第3-6天，“Pyoung”)与较大幼崽(出生后第16-18天，“Pold”)的细胞，二者在损伤后再生能力上存在差异。对于每个培养物，我们使用荧光标记的神经元、胶质细胞和未成熟/祖细胞标志物评估了标志物定义的细胞组成，并利用无标记扫描离子电导显微镜(SICM)表征了其纳米级分辨率的三维形态。Pyoung培养物随时间表现出活跃的形态变化，含有更高比例的未成熟SOX2细胞，并在损伤后向损伤部位生长出更多神经突(TUJ1)。此外，Pold培养物表现出更稳定的胞体大小(如厚度、面积、体积)，培养早期具有更大的星形胶质(SOX9)群体，以及以胶质细胞为主的损伤反应。这些早期星形胶质包括更多未成熟或反应性(vimentin)星形胶质细胞。SICM进一步揭示了跨越损伤的细胞桥、损伤在基底上留下的脊纹以及对齐的神经突生长。在所有测量中，分子标志物的变化与细胞形态的相应变化相关联。因此，这种荧光标记与SICM的多模式组合将标志物定义的细胞组成与出生后体外发育过程中及之后的微观和纳米级特征的物理组织联系起来。

papers.title: Functional Performance of Electrospun Tissue-Engineered Heart Valve Scaffolds Across Geometries Under Aortic Conditions
papers.translated_title: 主动脉条件下不同几何形状的静电纺丝组织工程心脏瓣膜支架的功能性能
papers.author: Dillinger, H.
papers.summary: Electrospun, bioresorbable polymer scaffolds are a promising platform for tissue-engineered heart valves (TEHVs) owing to their fibrous microstructure, tunable mechanics and capacity to support host-cell infiltration and remodeling. Recent in-vitro parametric studies of bioprosthetic heart valve (BHV) geometry have used silicone cast valves to link design parameters to hemodynamic performance and leaflet strain, but the functional behavior of electrospun whole-valve TEHV scaffolds across distinct leaflet geometries and clinically relevant aortic conditions remains poorly characterized. Here, we present an end-to-end workflow in which polycaprolactone (PCL) is electrospun directly onto parametrized, 3D-printed mandrels derived from two established analytical leaflet geometry models, yielding 21 whole-valve scaffolds across four geometries without cutting and assembling flat fiber sheets or suturing of flat fiber sheets. Fiber diameter, orientation and pore area were assessed by scanning electron microscopy and found to be consistent across scaffolds and geometries. Two scaffolds of each of four geometries were tested in a pulse duplicator under hypotensive, normotensive and hypertensive aortic conditions. All scaffolds opened and closed physiologically under all conditions, with a mean maximum geometric orifice area (GOA) of 44.5% of the valve area and a mean peak transvalvular pressure gradient of 10mmHg. Leaflet geometry had no apparent systematic effect on flow and pressure waveforms or on GOA. The mean regurgitant fraction was 82%, most likely due to leakage through the porous fiber network rather than incomplete leaflet closure. Electrospun whole-valve scaffolds thus achieve favorable leaflet kinematics at clinically relevant aortic conditions and the presented workflow provides a reproducible, parametric framework for their fabrication and translation toward regenerative heart valve replacement.
papers.translated_summary: 静电纺丝、生物可吸收聚合物支架因其纤维微结构、可调力学性能以及支持宿主细胞浸润和重塑的能力，成为组织工程心脏瓣膜（TEHVs）的有前景平台。近期关于生物假体心脏瓣膜（BHV）几何形状的体外参数化研究使用硅胶浇铸瓣膜将设计参数与血流动力学性能和瓣叶应变联系起来，但静电纺丝全瓣膜TEHV支架在不同瓣叶几何形状和临床相关主动脉条件下的功能行为仍表征不足。在此，我们提出了一种端到端工作流程，其中聚己内酯（PCL）被直接静电纺丝到参数化的3D打印芯轴上，这些芯轴源自两种已建立的分析性瓣叶几何模型，从而在四种几何形状下产出21个全瓣膜支架，无需切割和组装平坦纤维片材或缝合平坦纤维片材。通过扫描电子显微镜评估纤维直径、取向和孔面积，发现其在支架和几何形状之间保持一致。四种几何形状中各有两个支架在脉冲复制器中于低血压、正常血压和高血压主动脉条件下进行测试。所有支架在所有条件下均生理性开启和关闭，平均最大几何开口面积（GOA）为瓣膜面积的44.5%，平均峰值跨瓣压力梯度为10mmHg。瓣叶几何形状对流量和压力波形或GOA没有明显的系统性影响。平均反流分数为82%，最可能是由于通过多孔纤维网络的泄漏而非瓣叶关闭不完全所致。因此，静电纺丝全瓣膜支架在临床相关主动脉条件下实现了有利的瓣叶运动学，所提出的工作流程为其制造和向再生心脏瓣膜置换的转化提供了可重复的参数化框架。

papers.title: A reformulation of the t-test in single-cell transcriptomics dramatically reduces false positives
papers.translated_title: 单细胞转录组学中t检验的重构大幅减少了假阳性
papers.author: Kviman, O.
papers.summary: The default differential expression tests in single-cell analysis software provide fast and simple approaches that help practitioners annotate cell populations identified through clustering algorithms. Here, we use theoretical arguments and empirical studies to show that these tests suffer from inflated false positive rates that affect the resulting annotations. We introduce LN's t-test, which tests a novel, asymptotically unbiased log-fold change estimator and avoids these false positives, without compromising speed.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞分析软件中的默认差异表达检验提供了快速简便的方法，帮助研究人员对通过聚类算法识别出的细胞群体进行注释。在此，我们通过理论论证和实证研究表明，这些检验存在假阳性率偏高的问题，会影响所得的注释结果。我们提出了LN的t检验，该检验针对一种新的、渐近无偏的对数倍数变化估计量进行检验，避免了这些假阳性，同时不牺牲速度。

papers.title: Modulating inter-mitochondrial contacts to increase membrane potential for mitigating blue light damage
papers.translated_title: 调节线粒体间接触以提高膜电位从而减轻蓝光损伤
papers.author: Wang, Y.
papers.summary: Mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP) is essential for mitochondrial functions, yet current methods for modulating MMP lack precise spatial and temporal control. Here, we developed an optogenetic mitochondrial tethering system, termed OptoMitoTether, that enables reversible control of inter-mitochondrial proximity with high spatiotemporal precision. Blue light activation induced CRY2PHR oligomerization between adjacent mitochondrial outer membranes, reduced mitochondrial nearest-neighbor distances, and promoted inter-mitochondrial tethering. OptoMitoTether activation was associated with elevated MMP and was associated with lower reactive oxygen species (ROS) and preserved ATP production during prolonged blue light stress. Moreover, OptoMitoTether expression preserved mitochondrial bioenergetic function in human retinal cells and extended lifespan in C. elegans during chronic blue light exposure. These findings establish OptoMitoTether as a tool for manipulating mitochondrial proximity and reveal a link between inter-mitochondrial tethering and mitochondrial bioenergetic state during blue light stress.
papers.translated_summary: 线粒体膜电位（MMP）对线粒体功能至关重要，但现有调控MMP的方法缺乏精确的时空控制。在此，我们开发了一种光遗传学线粒体拴系系统，称为OptoMitoTether，能够以高时空精度可逆地控制线粒体间的邻近关系。蓝光激活诱导相邻线粒体外膜之间的CRY2PHR寡聚化，减小线粒体最近邻距离，并促进线粒体间拴系。OptoMitoTether激活与MMP升高相关，并与延长蓝光应激期间活性氧（ROS）降低和ATP产生维持相关。此外，OptoMitoTether表达在人视网膜细胞中保持了线粒体生物能量功能，并在慢性蓝光暴露期间延长了秀丽隐杆线虫的寿命。这些发现确立了OptoMitoTether作为操纵线粒体邻近关系的工具，并揭示了蓝光应激期间线粒体间拴系与线粒体生物能量状态之间的联系。

papers.title: Systematic comparison of gliflozins identifies a selective anti-calcifying effect of canagliflozin beyond canonical SGLT2 inhibition
papers.translated_title: 系统比较格列净类药物发现，卡格列净在经典SGLT2抑制之外具有选择性抗钙化作用
papers.author: Fernandez, L.
papers.summary: Background: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) provide important cardiorenal benefits in chronic kidney disease (CKD), but their effects on vascular calcification remain conflicting. Whether potential anti-calcifying effects are shared across gliflozins or involve mechanisms beyond canonical SGLT2 inhibition is unknown. Methods: We systematically compared canagliflozin, dapagliflozin and empagliflozin in a high-phosphate diet-induced mouse model of vascular calcification and complementary ex vivo and in vitro models, including rodent and human vascular tissues and vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs). Aortic transcriptional response was investigated by RNA sequencing. VSMC calcification, proliferation, migration, viability, glucose uptake and bioenergetics were investigated using complementary cellular assays, including OsteoSense staining, Annexin V/propidium iodide staining, radiolabeled 2-deoxyglucose uptake and Seahorse ATP rate analysis. SGLT2/1 expression was examined by RT-qPCR, Western blotting and immunofluorescence. We also evaluated sotagliflozin, a dual SGLT1/2 inhibitor, and mizagliflozin, a selective SGLT1 inhibitor. Results: Among the three gliflozins, only canagliflozin significantly reduced aortic calcification in vivo. Its anti-calcifying effect was also observed in rodent aortic rings, human vascular explants, cultured VSMCs and aortic rings from diabetic db/db mice. Aortic RNA-seq revealed that canagliflozin partially reversed HPD-induced transcriptional alterations, including changes in pro-calcific signaling and cellular metabolism, while some endothelial and inflammatory responses were shared among gliflozins. In mouse VSMCs, canagliflozin reduced calcification across all tested concentrations, dose-dependently decreased osteogenic marker expression, and reduced proliferation and migration. Increased apoptotic and damaged cell fractions were observed at higher concentrations, but not at lower concentrations. Canagliflozin also reduced glucose uptake and mitochondrial ATP production, without significantly affecting glycolytic ATP production. Neither dapagliflozin nor empagliflozin reproduced these cellular and metabolic effects at any of the concentrations tested. SGLT2 and SGLT1 expression was low or undetectable in vascular tissues and cells, and neither sotagliflozin nor mizagliflozin reproduced the anti-calcifying effect of canagliflozin in vivo or in vitro. Conclusions: Canagliflozin exhibits a selective anti-calcifying profile among the gliflozins tested, associated with changes in VSMC responses and cellular metabolism. These findings suggest that its vascular protective effects may involve mechanisms beyond canonical SGLT2 inhibition.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2i）在慢性肾脏病（CKD）中提供重要的心肾获益，但其对血管钙化的影响仍存在争议。潜在抗钙化作用是否在各列净类药物中共享，或是否涉及超越经典SGLT2抑制的机制，尚不清楚。方法：我们在高磷饮食诱导的小鼠血管钙化模型及互补的离体和体外模型中，系统比较了卡格列净、达格列净和恩格列净，包括啮齿类和人类血管组织及血管平滑肌细胞（VSMCs）。通过RNA测序研究主动脉转录反应。使用互补的细胞实验研究VSMC钙化、增殖、迁移、活力、葡萄糖摄取和生物能量学，包括OsteoSense染色、Annexin V/碘化丙啶染色、放射性标记2-脱氧葡萄糖摄取和Seahorse ATP速率分析。通过RT-qPCR、Western blotting和免疫荧光检测SGLT2/1表达。我们还评估了索格列净（双重SGLT1/2抑制剂）和米格列净（选择性SGLT1抑制剂）。结果：在三种列净类药物中，仅卡格列净在体内显著减少主动脉钙化。其抗钙化作用也在啮齿类主动脉环、人类血管外植体、培养的VSMCs和糖尿病db/db小鼠主动脉环中观察到。主动脉RNA-seq显示，卡格列净部分逆转了HPD诱导的转录改变，包括促钙化信号和细胞代谢的变化，而一些内皮和炎症反应在各列净类药物中共享。在小鼠VSMCs中，卡格列净在所有测试浓度下均减少钙化，剂量依赖性降低成骨标志物表达，并减少增殖和迁移。在较高浓度下观察到凋亡和受损细胞比例增加，但在较低浓度下未观察到。卡格列净还减少葡萄糖摄取和线粒体ATP产生，而未显著影响糖酵解ATP产生。达格列净和恩格列净在任何测试浓度下均未重现这些细胞和代谢效应。SGLT2和SGLT1在血管组织和细胞中表达低或不可检测，索格列净和米格列净在体内或体外均未重现卡格列净的抗钙化作用。结论：在所测试的列净类药物中，卡格列净表现出选择性抗钙化特征，与VSMC反应和细胞代谢的变化相关。这些发现表明其血管保护作用可能涉及超越经典SGLT2抑制的机制。

papers.title: A Double Challenge: Cerebral Blood Flow During Concurrent Breath-Hold and Motor Task
papers.translated_title: 双重挑战：屏气与运动任务同时进行时的脑血流量
papers.author: Jakobsen, K.
papers.summary: Motor activation and breath-holding probe complementary aspects of cerebrovascular function: the response to local neuronal demand and to a global vascular challenge. Combining them tests whether local perfusion responses remain supported when the cerebral circulation must also accommodate a systemic perturbation, potentially revealing constraints that either challenge alone would miss. We used arterial spin labelling (ASL) MRI to investigate whether concurrent breath-holding modifies the regional cerebral blood flow (CBF) response to motor activation. Fourteen healthy volunteers underwent pseudo-continuous ASL at 3T during sequential finger tapping with normal breathing, finger tapping during breath-holding, and breath-holding alone. Each condition included a resting baseline followed by eight 25-second task blocks interleaved with recovery. CBF responses were assessed using whole-brain voxelwise analyses and participant-specific primary motor cortex (M1) and supplementary motor area (SMA) regions. Baseline CBF was equivalent across conditions within predefined bounds of 10% either side. Motor-related perfusion increases remained detectable during concurrent breath-holding, but the mean M1 CBF increase was 26.5%, compared with 51.3% during normal breathing - a difference of 24.8 percentage points (p < 0.001). Corresponding SMA responses were 23.2% and 41.2%, although this difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.092). Breath-holding alone produced spatially heterogeneous responses, including regional CBF reductions. No significant global grey- or white-matter CBF changes from baseline were detected after correction for multiple comparisons. These findings demonstrate that a detectable motor perfusion response can coexist with substantial attenuation during a concurrent respiratory challenge, despite comparable resting perfusion. Combining global vascular and local neuronal challenges may reveal constraints on regional perfusion responses that are not apparent from either challenge alone, providing a framework for investigating cerebrovascular adaptability and its potential impairment in disease.
papers.translated_summary: 运动激活与屏气探测脑血管功能的互补方面：对局部神经元需求的反应和对全局血管挑战的反应。将两者结合可检验当脑循环还必须同时适应系统性扰动时，局部灌注反应是否仍能得到支持，从而可能揭示单独任一挑战都无法发现的约束。我们使用动脉自旋标记（ASL）MRI研究同步屏气是否改变运动激活引起的区域脑血流量（CBF）反应。14名健康志愿者在3T下接受伪连续ASL扫描，分别在进行正常呼吸下的序列手指敲击、屏气期间的手指敲击以及单独屏气时。每种条件均包括静息基线，随后是八个25秒的任务组块，组块之间穿插恢复期。CBF反应通过全脑体素分析和参与者特异性初级运动皮层（M1）及辅助运动区（SMA）区域进行评估。各条件间的基线CBF在预设的上下10%范围内相当。运动相关灌注增加在同步屏气期间仍可检测到，但M1的平均CBF增加为26.5%，而正常呼吸期间为51.3%——相差24.8个百分点（p < 0.001）。相应的SMA反应分别为23.2%和41.2%，尽管该差异无统计学显著性（p = 0.092）。单独屏气产生空间异质性反应，包括区域CBF降低。经多重比较校正后，未检测到全脑灰质或白质CBF较基线的显著变化。这些发现表明，尽管静息灌注相当，可检测的运动灌注反应可与同步呼吸挑战期间的大幅衰减共存。将全局血管挑战与局部神经元挑战相结合，可能揭示单独任一挑战均不明显的区域灌注反应约束，为研究脑血管适应性及其在疾病中的潜在损害提供了一个框架。
